GET/countries.sql: SELECT code, name_us, name_fr, region FROM countries ORDER BY name_us

GET/api/countries.sql: SELECT code, name_us, name_fr FROM countries ORDER BY name_us

GET/countries/:code.sql: SELECT code, name_us, name_fr FROM countries WHERE code=:code

GET/api/countries/:code.sql: SELECT code, name_us, name_fr FROM countries WHERE code=:code

POST/countries.sql: INSERT INTO countries (code, name_us, name_fr) VALUES (:code, :name_us, :name_fr) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name_us = :name_us, name_fr = :name_fr

PUT/countries/:code.sql: UPDATE countries SET name_us = :name_us, name_fr = :name_fr WHERE code = :code

GET/regions.sql: SELECT COALESCE(region, 'Unknown') AS region, COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM countries GROUP BY region ORDER BY country_count DESC

GET/api/regions.sql: SELECT COALESCE(region, 'Unknown') AS region, COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM countries GROUP BY region ORDER BY country_count DESC

GET/regions/:name.sql: SELECT code, name_us, name_fr FROM countries WHERE region = :name ORDER BY name_us
